# Vendored libraries

Copied as published, unchanged; loaded by `ui/index.html` with a `<script>` tag (there is no build step).

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sql-formatter.min.js` | [sql-formatter](https://github.com/sql-formatter-org/sql-formatter), `dist/sql-formatter.min.js` from npm | 15.8.2 | MIT, see `sql-formatter.LICENSE.txt` |

To update: `npm pack sql-formatter@<version>`, then copy `package/dist/sql-formatter.min.js` and `package/LICENSE` here and change the version above.
